info.title: mesh hub API
info.description: The HTTP API of `mesh hub`. Errors are JSON: { error, details? }. POST routes accept an idempotency key header for safe retries.

bearer.description: A token from `mesh login`, a machine token, or a service token.

session.name: mesh_session
session.description: The web dashboard's session (writes must come from the hub's own origin).

tags.name: daemon
tags.description: Used by `mesh up` on each machine.

get.summary: Liveness (kept for older clients; same as /healthz).
get.description: No authentication.

get.summary: Liveness: the process answers.
get.description: No authentication.

get.summary: Readiness: the database answers and is migrated (503 until then).
get.description: No authentication.

get.summary: The login providers this hub offers.
get.description: No authentication.

post.summary: Log in with a token provider (or the Solo hub's local provider).
post.description: No authentication.

get.summary: Start a browser (OIDC) login: redirects to the identity provider.
get.description: No authentication.

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: cli | web

parameters.name: cli_port
parameters.description: loopback port of a CLI login

parameters.name: cli_challenge
parameters.description: PKCE challenge of a CLI login

parameters.name: cli_mode
parameters.description: paste: the CLI can't receive a localhost redirect (a remote shell); the callback shows the one-time code to paste

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: machine name

get.summary: The identity provider's redirect back to the hub (a page with the one-time code for a CLI in paste mode).

post.summary: Poll a device-code login (202 while pending).
post.description: No authentication.

post.summary: Revoke the calling token or web session.
post.description: Any logged-in user (bearer token or web session).

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Repeat-safe retries: a repeated key returns the first response.
